column1: # CrayCare ESP32 partition table — 4 MB flash
#  - Single large app slot (3 MB) for the Firebase-ESP-Client firmware
#  - spiffs/littlefs data partition (~0.875 MB) for offline sensor buffering
#    (store-and-forward: ESP keeps sampling during WiFi outages and flushes
#    the backlog to Firestore when connectivity returns — zero data loss).
# Type/SubType names follow ESP-IDF conventions. LittleFS.begin() in the
# Arduino core mounts the partition labelled "spiffs" by default.
